root_cause: the orchestration driver used subprocess.run(timeout=2400s); run1 needed ~2403s (2.4 s/sample after a slow phase) so the child was killed at 998/1000. This is a driver timeout, not a data/model/evaluator failure and not the lease boundary (the lease had been extended).
improvement: for short leases never use a fixed subprocess timeout near the run estimate; on any partial stop, resume with the same run_id/config (--resume, no limit) and gate completion on summary + validation, not on the driver exit alone.
contamination: none: the aborted partial produced no summary/metrics; the resumed run covers the full 1000 rows and passed validation
